name: harmonic_le_one_add_log
result.value:
:= by
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · simp [hn0]
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn0
  simp_rw [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_inv, Rat.cast_natCast]
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add (Finset.Icc 1 n) _ (Finset.left_mem_Icc.mpr hn), add_comm, Nat.cast_one, inv_one]
  gcongr
  simp only [Finset.Icc_erase_left]
  calc
    ∑ d ∈ .Ico 2 (n + 1), (d : ℝ)⁻¹
    _ = ∑ d ∈ .Ico 2 (n + 1), (↑(d + 1) - 1)⁻¹ := ?_
    _ ≤ ∫ x in 2..↑(n + 1), (x - 1)⁻¹ := ?_
    _ = ∫ x in 1..n, x⁻¹ :=...
result.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, the $ n $-th harmonic number $ H_n $, defined as $ \sum_{k=1}^n \frac{1}{k} $, satisfies the inequality $ H_n \leq 1 + \ln(n) $, where $ \ln(n) $ denotes the natural logarithm of $ n $. This bound quantifies the asymptotic growth rate of harmonic numbers in terms of logarithmic functions.

name: ArithmeticFunction
vonMangoldt_le_log
result.value:
| 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [← vonMangoldt_sum]
    exact single_le_sum (by exact fun _ _ => vonMangoldt_nonneg) (mem_divisors_self _ n.succ_ne_zero)
result.informal_description: For every natural number $ n $, the von Mangoldt function $ \Lambda(n) $ satisfies $ \Lambda(n) \leq \ln(n) $.

name: Chebyshev
psi_le_const_mul_self
result.value:
:= by
  by_cases! hx : x < 1
  · rw [psi_eq_zero_of_lt_two (by linarith)]
    bound
  apply le_trans (psi_le hx)
  rw [add_mul]
  gcongr 1
  grw [sqrt_eq_rpow, log_le_rpow_div (ε := 1 / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith), ← mul_div_assoc, ← mul_one_div]
  nth_rw 2 [mul_assoc]
  rw [← rpow_add (by linarith)]
  norm_num
  linarith
result.informal_description: For any non-negative real number $ x $, the Chebyshev ψ function satisfies $ \psi(x) \leq (\ln 4 + 4)x $, where $ \psi(x) $ denotes the sum of the von Mangoldt function $ \Lambda(n) $ over all positive integers $ n \leq \lfloor x \rfloor $.

name: Real
sum_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i) : ∑ i ∈ s, √(f i) * √(g i) ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} {f g : ι → ℝ} (s : Finset ι),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ f i) → (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ g i) → ∑ i ∈ s, √(f i) * √(g i) ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i)
result.value: := by simpa [*] using sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ (fun x ↦ √(f x)) (fun x ↦ √(g x))
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Sums of Square Roots of Non-Negative Functions
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ and non-negative real-valued functions $ f $ and $ g $ defined on $ s $, the inequality $ \sum_{i \in s} \sqrt{f(i)} \cdot \sqrt{g(i)} \leq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} f(i)} \cdot \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} g(i)} $ holds.

name: NNReal

result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → NNReal),
  ∑ i ∈ s, NNReal.sqrt (f i) * NNReal.sqrt (g i) ≤ NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, g i)
result.value: := by simpa [*] using sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ (fun x ↦ sqrt (f x)) (fun x ↦ sqrt (g x))
result.informal_name: Square Root Sum Inequality in Non-negative Real Numbers
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of indices $ \iota $ and functions $ f, g : \iota \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $, the inequality $ \sum_{i \in s} \sqrt{f(i)} \cdot \sqrt{g(i)} \leq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} f(i)} \cdot \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} g(i)} $ holds, where all operations are performed in the non-negative real numbers $ \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $.
